response.reconstructed_markdown:
A normal fasting blood sugar level for adults in India is less than 100 mg/dL \(typically ranging between 70 mg/dL and 99 mg/dL\) after an overnight fast of at least 8 hours. [0] [1]

Medical institutions and diagnostic providers in India, aligned with global standards like the [Medanta Health Blog](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEB6zswFdu-X1pp4CK-6nZX5ijBLDtxDA37AjKlKl6H-c1QyNHeedoAAXs3RtQFi0_g7kr81Ugtnc4fVIt7V2lQfWzfVtEe9_E8co8pm-U-uhMFf4vrpdIG7Etuvzuo2mc_qPtdv2QhObATxORMLgzmCB5JyfvaDG9nHBRX_VugpKiqY9_JUAU0O32lrDKQMAxbztmiHdK4XZsk) and [Lupin Diagnostics](https://www.lupindiagnostics.com/blog/blood-sugar-level-chart-for-indians-age-wise), classify fasting plasma glucose into the following ranges:

| Category | Fasting Blood Glucose Range |
| --- | --- |
| Normal | 70 mg/dL to 99 mg/dL |
| Prediabetes | 100 mg/dL to 125 mg/dL |
| Diabetes | 126 mg/dL or higher \(confirmed via repeat testing\) |

- Lower Threshold Awareness: Due to higher genetic and metabolic predisposition to insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes in South Asian populations, doctors in India often recommend early screening starting around age 25. [1]
- Testing Conditions: A fasting blood sugar test requires no food or caloric intake for 8 to 10 hours prior to the blood draw \(water is permitted\).

If you or someone you know is monitoring their levels, would you like to know the normal post\-meal \(PP\) glucose ranges or the target HbA1c levels recommended for adults in India?
